key_points: JPMorgan strategists urge investors not to chase the equity sell-off triggered by oil-driven bond yield surge, calling it short-lived.
JPMorgan expects a Fed quarter-point rate hike this week, which could improve bank net interest margins.
JPMorgan turned bullish on Lithium Americas, giving a positive rating implying nearly 100% upside.
Institutional activity shows mixed buying and selling of JPM shares with no clear net direction.
No material JPM-specific news (earnings, guidance, M&A, regulatory) was reported.
